collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.before: the first villager to reach it notices
ledger.after: (name1), the first villager to reach it, notices
ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: On a scorching afternoon, the first villager to reach the only shady tree sees an older worker still in the sun.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: On a scorching afternoon, a crew repairing a fence has a single shady tree, and (name1), the first villager to reach it, notices an older worker with a cane still out in the sun.

choices.label: Rig a Second Shade from a Spare Mat.
Suggest the Whole Crew Rest Together.
Bring Water to Everyone Still Working.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The older worker accepts with a grateful nod, and the two take turns for the rest of the afternoon.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The older worker thanks them but says they are fine, and the offer is not pressed again.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Everyone squeezes under the branches, and the break turns into a lively talk.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The tree is too small for everyone, so they agree to stop work during the hottest hour instead.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The water is welcome, and the crew finishes without anyone becoming unwell.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The water runs out quickly, and the crew leader decides to finish tomorrow morning.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: Two poles and a mat give the whole crew a place to rest.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1
b1__text.text: Two poles and a mat give the whole crew a place to rest.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: The wind keeps tipping the mat over, and the crew ends up laughing at it more than resting.
